radio.desert.intro:
Tiger-1, this is Command. You're cut off. Head east
and find what's left of the outpost. Try not to dent it.
radio.desert.hatch:
That rear door isn't just for groceries. Grab the
hatch kit and send someone where the tank won't fit.
radio.desert.bunkers:
Bunker line ahead. They shoot through slits.
The back of a bunker is famously slit-free.
radio.desert.mortar:
A 60mm mortar! Lob it over walls and cliffs.
Aim for the switch, not the general.
radio.desert.steep:
That ramp's too steep for a Mk2. Come back with
better shocks. Or a better tank.
radio.desert.dozer:
Blade fitted. Somewhere, a pile of rubble
just felt a chill.
radio.desert.boss_approach:
Their command bunker is past this depot. It has a
rail gun. We have... enthusiasm. Repair first.
radio.desert.boss_intro:
Is that a gun on a TRAIN TRACK? Keep moving,
Tiger-1! Mortar its roof!
radio.desert.boss_down:
Bunker down! There's a crate in the rubble with your
name on it. Literally. Someone wrote 'Tiger-1'.
radio.desert.mk3:
Mk3 conversion complete. New gun, new shocks,
same smell. Steep ramps won't stop you now.
radio.desert.final_01:
...tank... you weren't supposed to get this far.
The thing under the hills is waking. Come north.
radio.desert.final_02:
Uh, Tiger-1? That wasn't us.
End of the slice. Nice driving!
